title: hypothesis.generation_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs HypothesisAgent to generate a HypothesisBank grounded in the frozen ResearchSpec and LiteratureBrief. Payload is intentionally minimal: both artifacts are read from the Research Store by ref.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

research_memory_ref.description: Optional prior ResearchMemory used to avoid repeating earlier ideas.
